latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of "Music To Your Video — Sync Music to Your Clips".

- Upload your video clips and receive 1080p MP4s with background music synced to your video's mood and rhythm.
- Automated setup: connects to a cloud backend, acquires a temporary token if needed, and manages sessions for you.
- Simple commands: add clips, generate synced music, export videos, check credits, and monitor status.
- Supports major video formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) up to 500MB.
- Fast cloud GPU rendering (30–90s typical) with free usage up to 100 credits.
- Guides users with clear prompts and automatically summarizes timeline edits and export jobs.
